response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, hands-on senior engineer with 15+ years of experience, strong testing culture, and some high-throughput distributed systems work, but the resume shows no experimentation platform, feature-flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or growth engineering experience — the core of this role. Career trajectory reflects senior/staff IC breadth across product and web work rather than the Principal-level (IC6) cross-organizational platform leadership and statistical experimentation depth required.
strengths: Deep hands-on engineering breadth across languages (TypeScript, C/C++, Java, DLang) and stacks
High-scale distributed systems experience at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic (millions of requests/sec, low-latency services)
Strong quality mindset: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling authorship, and community teaching/mentoring
concerns: No evidence of experimentation systems, A/B testing, feature flighting, or growth measurement work
Lacks demonstrated Principal-level scope: no multi-team platform ownership or cross-org architecture leadership
No stated experience with statistical analysis, metrics guardrails, or telemetry infrastructure at scale

key_factors.factor: Strong engineering fundamentals and scale exposure
